Plugin.Name: Docker Search
Plugin.Overview: Adds a live search box and quick filter buttons to the top of the Docker containers list. Type to filter by name, image, folder, network, IP or port, use terms like image:linuxserver or is:unhealthy, or click a button for running, stopped, healthy, unhealthy, update available, autostart, WebUI or CPU pinned, each with a live count. Folders from folder.view2 open automatically when they contain a match. Press / to search and Esc to clear. Doesn't change any stock files.
